note: 看不起玩家的贵族住户,语气要傲慢。

messages.raw: §fI don't really converse with your kind, but today I'll make an exception.
messages.text: I don't really converse with your kind, but today I'll make an exception.
messages.zh: 我一般不跟你们这种人交谈,不过今天就破例一次。

messages.raw: §fThis is acceptable. I would never eat this myself, but it's good enough for my servants.
messages.text: This is acceptable. I would never eat this myself, but it's good enough for my servants.
messages.zh: 这个还行。我自己是绝不会吃的,不过赏给仆人倒是够了。

messages.raw: §fMy disappointment is immeasurable. What a waste of my valuable time.
messages.text: My disappointment is immeasurable. What a waste of my valuable time.
messages.zh: 我的失望无以言表。真是白白浪费我宝贵的时间。
